p2.goal: Protocol B pilot p2 (inner_train -> inner_dev; official test not decoded). (a) Literature baselines not run before, paper settings, 3 seeds: DLO and ILO (Hu et al. 2022; top-3 lowest-entropy orders of the pre-trained model, lr 1e-4), MvP (Gou et al. 2023; top-5 orders by log-probability as prompted views, majority vote, lr 1e-4), Review Combination (Findings NAACL 2025; Algorithm 1, the combined set replaces train). (b) Self-training with a pseudo-label scorer (Zhang et al. ACL 2024) without external data: unlabelled texts = syn_infill texts whose source is in inner_train (data/aug/st_pool_inner.jsonl); comparison data = gold labels of inner_train vs beam candidates of 5 cross-validation models; scorer = ViT5-base, listwise + NLL; filters: confidence >= 0.7 then scorer band top 10-40 %; reranking of 4 beam candidates at inference. dv_st_conf = confidence filter only, same size (isolates the scorer filter); dv_none_rr = no augmentation + reranking (isolates reranking). Go rule written before results: dv_st reranked inner_dev F1 (5 seeds) >= dv_none + 2.0. Added after p2_s1/s2 (2026-11-02): dv_none_lr1e4 = no augmentation at lr 1e-4 (control for the lr of DLO/ILO/MvP). Re-run of the ST chain after two fixes: candidates OOM on long texts (st_pl_0/1 failed), and the comparison positive written in gold quad order while negatives were sorted (order shortcut; first scorer and dv_none_rr kept locally as outputs/*_shortcut). lr choice (written 2026-11-02, before any result at the new lrs): lr in {1e-4, 2e-4, 3e-4} with the highest mean inner_dev F1 of no augmentation over 5 seeds (dv_none_lr1e4, dv_none_lr2e4, dv_none); it fills vars.lr, and every run that waits for it is then trained at that lr (the ST chain, and ADA joint, concat, EDA, GenDA, infill_t, RC rebuilt from inner_train; DLO/ILO/MvP again only if the lr is not 1e-4; *_lrsel runs whose lr equals an existing run are dropped). Chosen after p2_s3: lr 1e-4 (no augmentation, 5 seeds: 1e-4 63.94, 2e-4 62.46, 3e-4 61.35); DLO/ILO/MvP already at 1e-4. After p2_s4/s5: the confidence filter was broken (finished beams are filled with EOS, and EOS after EOS counted in the min token probability) -> 29 of 12,217 pseudo-labels kept, so dv_st / dv_st_conf were in effect no augmentation (moved locally to outputs/*_confbug); fixed and the ST arm re-run (teacher, scorer, select, dv_st, dv_st_conf); dv_none_rr and the baselines are unaffected. Go rule (unchanged threshold, same lr on both sides): dv_st reranked mean of 5 seeds >= no augmentation at the chosen lr + 2.0.

Students: single-view Paraphrase on inner_train + the set. Also dv_mvp seeds 7 and 99 (MvP to 5 seeds, same configuration as p2). Written 2026-11-03 before any p3 result. Go rule: dv_mvd greedy inner_dev F1, mean of 5 seeds >= no augmentation at 1e-4 (dv_none_lr1e4, 63.94) + 2.0 = 65.94. Secondary (reported, not for the decision): dv_mvd vs dv_st_conf (single-view teacher, same pool and size: isolates the multi-view teacher); dv_mvd vs dv_mvd_all (agreement filter); implicit-type slices; MvP 5 seeds vs no augmentation. Student + MvP vote vs MvP only if the go rule passes (a later session).

p5.goal: Protocol B pilot p5 (inner_train -> inner_dev; official test not decoded), lr 1e-4. Written 2026-11-03 before any p5 result, after the second literature survey. Go rule (1): dv_pos mean of 10 seeds >= dv_none_lr1e4 mean of the same 10 seeds + 2.0. (2) is exploratory (one soup per group): reported against the mean of its 5 ingredients and against their majority-vote ensemble; promising if both dv_pos uniform soups are >= their ingredient mean + 2.0. Secondary: Welch dv_pos vs dv_none; recall by number of gold quads and by position third; implicit types. If p4 (ensemble distillation) fails, its re-run with text-order labels and the full pool is planned after p4 is in.

Question: does a stronger teacher, or gold-side augmentation in the student, raise the method on all three datasets? 2 x 2 design, every cell text order, lr 1e-4: teacher in {plain, ADA (teachers trained on inner_train + ADA joint of inner_train, batch 8 x grad_accum 2)} x student data in {inner_train + voted pool, inner_train + voted pool + ADA joint (batch 8 x 2)}. Teachers: 5 seeds (42 123 2024 7 99) with checkpoints, each greedy-labels the inner pool (sources in inner_train only), vote >= 3/5 with grounded spans, all kept; teacher checkpoints deleted after the vote. Students: 3 seeds (42 123 2024) with checkpoints, then uniform + greedy soup of the 3 seeds. Vi reuses p4 plain teachers and p6 dv_ens_full_pos (v1 cell, seeds 42 123 2024; its p6 soup used 4 seeds). ACOS inner split = fold 0 of kfold.py split --k 5 --seed 42 (the Vi rule): Rest 1,224 / 306, Laptop 2,347 / 587; inner pools Rest 9,044, Laptop 16,941; ADA joint of inner_train Rest 2,181, Laptop 7,422 (Vi dv_ada_joint 2,902). Plain-teacher and ADA-teacher runs also give M0 and ADA-alone on inner_dev (5 seeds). Phase 1 = teachers, labels, votes; phase 2 (vars) = students once the voted sets are ingested and pushed. DECISION RULE (fixed now): gain_d(X) = mean inner_dev F1 of cell X minus v1, same seeds, per dataset d. The cell with the largest mean gain over the 3 datasets replaces v1 if that mean gain >= +0.5 and no dataset has gain < -0.5; otherwise v1 stays. Uniform soup becomes part of the method if, for the chosen cell, soup minus its ingredients' mean is >= 0 on all 3 datasets and >= +0.3 on average (inference cost unchanged). Also reported: each cell vs M0 and vs ADA alone; a dataset where the chosen recipe is below ADA alone is flagged. 3 seeds: minimum detectable difference ~2 F1, so the rule picks a direction; the chosen method is then confirmed in a pre-registered round on test.

ds.goal:
TRAINING-SIZE CURVE (pre-registered 2026-11-19 before any ds run). How does the gain of the proposed method change when only p % of the gold training set is available? Design follows published practice (agent survey of 20 papers, notes): size grid = MvP's 1/2/5/10/20 % (Gou et al. 2023; also STAR, Review Combination) plus 50 %; 100 % = the existing cv / ac / al / cf runs on the same seeds. Subsets: nested (1 within 2 ... within 50), stratified by each review's rarest category (stratified / class-balanced sampling: Hellwig et al. 2025, Piedboeuf and Langlais 2025, Pecher et al. 2024), one fixed draw (seed 13; src/aug/gold_subsets.py; ASQP papers do not state their draw). Everything the method uses is built from the subset only (DS2-ABSA, Hellwig, Torres et al.): pool = GPT texts whose source review is in the subset (st_scorer pool; texts close to any review outside the subset dropped), ADA joint of the subset, MvP order scores of the subset, 5 MvP teachers trained on the subset. Dev and test = the official sets, unchanged (Torres et al.); dev only selects checkpoints. Arms per (dataset, p), 5 seeds (42 123 2024 7 99), same configurations as the main study: baseline; MvP (= the 5 teachers, top-5 views); proposed (subset gold + majority-of-25-views vote of the subset pool + subset ADA, text order, batch 8 x 2); Copy (subset gold duplicated to the proposed student's example count, text order, batch 8 x 2: same steps, no new information; Piedboeuf and Langlais 2025). Phase 1 = order scores, baseline, MvP teachers + pool labels; the vote and the Copy sets are made locally; phase 2 (vars ds__f

) = proposed and Copy. ANALYSIS: per dataset, proposed > baseline at each p, two-sided Welch on per-seed test quad F1, Holm over the 6 sizes; secondary (uncorrected): proposed vs MvP and vs Copy at each p; the gain curve over p including 100 %; effective data multiplier (the gold fraction the baseline needs to reach the proposed score, interpolated on log p; Geiping et al. 2023). Expected from the literature: gains larger at small p, shrinking with size. Test blind until all ds jobs are in.

cp.goal: COPY CONTROL AT 100 % (pre-registered 2026-11-19, before any cp run; motivated by ds, where the size-matched Copy arm recovered most of the proposed gain at 50 % on Rest: baseline 54.75, Copy 57.63, proposed 58.14). Question: is the main-study gain of the proposed method more than the effect of training longer on gold? Arm Copy = gold train + gold duplicated to |cv vote| + |ADA joint| rows (src/aug/copy_gold.py, seed 13; Vi 19,348, Rest 13,625, Laptop 27,151), text order, batch 8 x 2, the proposed student's configuration with only --aug_path changed. Seeds = the proposed arm's: Vi 5 (42 123 2024 7 99; cv), Rest and Laptop 18 (the mx seeds). PRIMARY: per dataset, proposed (cv_<d>_v2) > Copy, two-sided Welch on per-seed test quad F1, Holm over the 3 datasets. SECONDARY: Copy vs baseline (same seeds); proposed - Copy CI. n fixed.

am.goal:
AUGMENTATION-AMOUNT CURVE (pre-registered 2026-11-19 before any am run; grid chosen by the user). Gold train stays at 100 %; only the amount of augmented data varies: p = 10, 20, 30, 50, 80 % of the proposed method's augmented set (cv vote + ADA joint), each part subsampled separately at the same p so the mixture is unchanged; nested (10 within 20 ... within 80), stratified by each item's rarest category, seed 13 (src/aug/gold_subsets.py applied to the augmented files; data/aug/am//p

/). p = 0 = baseline (ac/cf none) and p = 100 = proposed (cv__v2), both existing, seeds A. Arms per (dataset, p), seeds A (42 123 2024 7 99), the proposed student's configuration (text order, batch 8 x 2, lr 1e-4), only --aug_path changes: proposed = gold + p % vote + p % ADA; Copy = gold + gold duplicated to the same row count (src/aug/copy_gold.py, seed 13; Copy at 100 % = round cp). ANALYSIS: PRIMARY per dataset, trend: OLS slope of per-seed test quad F1 of the proposed arm on log10 p over p = 10 ... 100 (30 runs), t-test of slope > 0 reported two-sided, Holm over the 3 datasets. SECONDARY (no correction): each p vs baseline (Welch); proposed vs Copy at each p (Welch); smallest p whose mean is within 0.5 F1 of p = 100 (saturation). Test blind until all am jobs are in.
